brief.summary: Marc Odermatt rents a studio at Rosenbergweg 3, Burgdorf from Emmental Liegenschaften GmbH. He reports water entering through the bathroom ceiling and that after he asked for a rent reduction, the caretaker orally told him the owner wanted him out by year-end. He has not received the letter and does not know the proposed dates. He suspects retaliation and wants to contest the termination. The notice, service date, end date, stated grounds and tenancy terms are not available. Relevant papers to request include the lease, written termination notice, proof and date of receipt, and landlord correspondence about the defect and termination. No calendar dates are given in the message.

reply.subject: Your question about the landlord’s stated intention to end the tenancy

clauses.text: You say that the caretaker orally told you the owner wanted you to leave by the end of the year, and that you are still waiting for the letter.
You also say that you wrote twice about water entering through the bathroom ceiling and asked for a rent reduction, and that you believe the intended termination is connected to those complaints.

Please send us the written termination notice as soon as you receive it, together with any proof showing when and how it was delivered, so that the issuer, dates, and applicable time limits can be checked.

Please also provide a copy of your lease and copies of your letters about the water ingress and rent reduction, together with any replies or other correspondence from the landlord about the defect or the proposed termination.
If available, dated photographs or inspection and repair records relating to the water ingress could also help.
